class.name: TweensGdChain
class.brief_description: A linked timeline of definitions on one target.
class.description: Created by Tweens.chain(target, definitions, owner, options) or TweensGdScheduler.add_chain. A signed delay links to the previous entry's own end; negative gaps overlap. Completion waits for all tails. Entries capture at activation after existing writes and completion callbacks. Negative starts pre-roll crossed lifecycle hooks chronologically on the first eligible update. Pause and cancellation control the root, including through active leaf handles. Pending discarded entries run no playback or prepare/release hooks. C# equivalent: Chain. Multiple-target and nested composition are not supported.

method.name: wait
method.description: Waits for settlement. Cancellation affects only this wait.
